issues.description: The Person.birthday attribute is declared as LocalDate in the problem statement and in the template repository, but in the solution repository Person.birthday is declared as String. This creates a structural inconsistency: many parts of the code (e.g., PersonScene, PersonService, and client/server interactions) expect a LocalDate and will not compile or will behave unexpectedly against the solution model. This is an internal contradiction in the solution repository and contradicts the specified model in the problem/template, and thus would confuse students (and break compilation/serialization).
issues.suggested_fix: Make the Person.birthday type consistent with the problem statement and template by changing the solution repository's Person.birthday to use java.time.LocalDate (update getter/setter accordingly). Ensure all usages (PersonScene, PersonService, serialization/deserialization) operate on LocalDate so the client/server code compiles and behaves as intended.
